title: Zesty Grassy Irish Lamb Tagine
description: A kid-friendly Irish dish featuring garlic bulb, cooked in a tagine on a cedar plank, with a grassy and fluffy texture, diabetic-friendly and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb pieces, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and chopped mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the olive oil mixture over the lamb mixture and toss to coat.
Place the cedar plank in the oven for 5 minutes to heat it up.
Remove the cedar plank from the oven and place the lamb mixture on it.
Cover the lamb with a tagine or a foil tent and cook for 2.5 hours.
Remove the tagine or foil tent and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before serving.
